stem.text: The diagram shows the variation of a quantity $y$ with a quantity $x$ for objects in a uniform gravitational field.

stem.alt: Graph with the vertical axis labelled y and the horizontal axis labelled x, origin marked 0; a curve starts at the origin and rises steeply to the right.

A.text: mass for different objects moving at the same speed; kinetic energy

B.text: speed for an object of constant mass; kinetic energy

C.text: vertical distance fallen for an object of constant mass; change of gravitational potential energy

D.text: mass for different objects falling the same vertical distance; change of gravitational potential energy
